title: citrus × aurantium var. bergamia
intro: Citrus × aurantium var. bergamia, commonly known as bergamot, is a variety of citrus plant that belongs to the Rutaceae family. Bergamot is prized for its numerous health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving mood, and alleviating symptoms of insomnia, due to its calming and soothing effects on the nervous system. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as bergapten, bergamotene, and limonene, have therapeutic actions that include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for skin care and wound healing. The essential oil extracted from bergamot, bergamot essential oil, is widely used in aromatherapy for its uplifting and calming effects.
